scope: Australia medical discovery — UNSW Bachelor of Medical Studies/Doctor of Medicine

International applicants must use UCAT ANZ or ISAT and complete the relevant application process; UAC dates are published for applicants completing Australian/NZ Year 12 or IB.
UNSW lists a 2026 indicative international first-year fee of AUD 95,500 and indicative full fee of AUD 647,000.
